trustPolicy.loadError: The trust policy could not be loaded.
trustPolicy.saveError: The trust policy could not be saved.

weights.title: Score weights
weights.description: How much each signal counts toward a viewer's trust score. The four must add up to exactly 1.

growth.title: Growth speed
growth.description: How fast each signal reaches its full value. A higher number grows more slowly.

boosts.title: Boosts and multipliers
boosts.description: Extra trust for known good accounts, and a cut for accounts that do not follow.

penalties.title: Penalties
penalties.description: How much score a viewer loses for each moderation action.

tiers.title: Tier ceilings
tiers.description: The highest score that still belongs to each tier. Each ceiling must be higher than the one before.

heat.title: Heat
heat.description: How fast heat fades and how much each event adds.

requestCountWeight.title: Request count
requestCountWeight.help: Weight of how many requests the viewer made.

accountAgeWeight.title: Account age
accountAgeWeight.help: Weight of how old the viewer's account is.

contentAgeWeight.title: Content age
contentAgeWeight.help: Weight of how old the requested content is.

contentPopularityWeight.title: Content popularity
contentPopularityWeight.help: Weight of how popular the requested content is.

requestCountDecay.title: Request count growth
requestCountDecay.help: How slowly the request count signal reaches its full value.

accountAgeDecay.title: Account age growth
accountAgeDecay.help: How slowly the account age signal reaches its full value.

contentAgeDecay.title: Content age growth
contentAgeDecay.help: How slowly the content age signal reaches its full value.

contentPopularityDecay.title: Content popularity growth
contentPopularityDecay.help: How slowly the content popularity signal reaches its full value.

reputationBoostEnabled.title: Reputation boost
reputationBoostEnabled.help: Give extra trust to affiliates, partners and verified YouTube channels.

affiliateBoost.title: Affiliate boost
affiliateBoost.help: Points added for a Twitch affiliate.

partnerBoost.title: Partner boost
partnerBoost.help: Points added for a Twitch partner.

verifiedYouTubeBoost.title: Verified YouTube boost
verifiedYouTubeBoost.help: Points added for a verified YouTube channel.

notFollowingFactor.title: Not following multiplier
notFollowingFactor.help: The score is multiplied by this when the viewer does not follow the channel.

youTubeQualityPenaltyFactor.title: YouTube quality multiplier
youTubeQualityPenaltyFactor.help: The score is multiplied by this for low quality YouTube content.

skipPenalty.title: Skip penalty
skipPenalty.help: Points lost when a viewer's request is skipped.

timeoutPenalty.title: Timeout penalty
timeoutPenalty.help: Points lost when a viewer is timed out.

banPenalty.title: Ban penalty
banPenalty.help: Points lost when a viewer is banned.

untrustedMax.title: Untrusted up to
untrustedMax.help: Scores up to this value are untrusted.

lowMax.title: Low trust up to
lowMax.help: Scores up to this value are low trust.

standardMax.title: Standard up to
standardMax.help: Scores up to this value are standard. Above it is high trust.

heatHalfLifeHours.title: Heat half-life (hours)
heatHalfLifeHours.help: Hours it takes for heat to fall by half.

heatDeltaBan.title: Heat for a ban
heatDeltaBan.help: Heat added when a viewer is banned.

heatDeltaTimeout.title: Heat for a timeout
heatDeltaTimeout.help: Heat added when a viewer is timed out.

heatDeltaReportValidated.title: Heat for a confirmed report
heatDeltaReportValidated.help: Heat added when a report about a viewer is confirmed.

heatDeltaAutoModDenied.title: Heat for a denied AutoMod message
heatDeltaAutoModDenied.help: Heat added when AutoMod holds back a viewer's message.

heatDeltaFilterHit.title: Heat for a filter hit
heatDeltaFilterHit.help: Heat added when a viewer's message trips a chat filter.

error.weightsMustSumToOne: The four score weights must add up to exactly 1.
error.weightOutOfRange: A score weight must be between 0 and 1.
error.decayOutOfRange: A growth speed must be above 0 and within the allowed maximum.
error.factorOutOfRange: A multiplier must be between 0 and 1.
error.boostOutOfRange: This boost is outside the allowed range.
error.penaltyOutOfRange: This penalty is outside the allowed range.
error.tiersMustAscend: Each tier ceiling must be higher than the one before it.
error.tierOutOfRange: A tier ceiling must be between 0 and 100.
error.heatHalfLifeOutOfRange: The heat half-life is outside the allowed range.
error.heatDeltaOutOfRange: This heat amount is outside the allowed range.
